propositions: compact.py at 798 LOC (2 under 800-LOC cap) bundles three responsibilities: compaction transaction (_compact_locked, CCN 24), snapshot reconstruction (rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log, CCN 21), and CLI surface in one file, flagged for both size and complexity

Refactor compact.py into a thin CLI facade by extracting _compact_locked and snapshot primitives into compact_txn.py, and rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log into compact_rebuild.py, with shared helpers (_build_authorship_ledger, _snapshot_strip_keys, _git_author, _git) in compact_txn to avoid circular imports

Move _REBUILD_COUNT and get_rebuild_count to compact_rebuild.py where rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log does global _REBUILD_COUNT, then re-export get_rebuild_count from compact.py to preserve import paths and ensure the counter increments through the same module global

Re-export moved symbols (rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log, _snapshot_strip_keys, _build_authorship_ledger, get_rebuild_count) from compact.py to preserve all consumer import paths in fsck_repair.py, fsck_restore.py, and test files without editing them

Repoint two module-object monkeypatch seams in test_compact_negative.py: setattr(_compact, '_git', ...) to setattr(compact_txn, '_git', ...) and setattr(_compact.lock, ...) to use the _lock already imported in compact.py

Reduce cyclomatic complexity by extracting named helper functions from _compact_locked and rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log, remove all three compact.py entries from complexity-baseline.json (shrink-only ratchet), and add new test proving counter co-location via real rebuild call
